comparison_a.a01: I finally cleaned out my inbox. Zero unread for the first time in about four years.
comparison_a.a02: Can you walk me through how compound interest works, quickly? I always forget.
comparison_a.a03: My grandmother's recipe book turned up in a box in the attic. Her handwriting is all over the margins.
comparison_a.a04: The client moved the deadline up to Friday. That's two days early and nothing's ready.
comparison_a.a05: Read me back the three things I said I'd do today: email Priya, fix the login bug, and book the dentist.
comparison_a.a06: You booked the restaurant for the wrong night. We showed up and they had nothing for us.
comparison_a.a07: Tell me a bedtime story about a lighthouse keeper and a very polite seagull. Short.
comparison_a.a08: My laptop died in the middle of the presentation. In front of everyone.
comparison_a.a09: What's a good way to keep basil alive indoors? Mine always wilts.
comparison_a.a10: My brother and I haven't spoken in a year, and he just texted me happy birthday.
comparison_a.a11: I've got jury duty next week. No idea what to expect.
comparison_a.a12: We found out we're having twins.
comparison_a.a13: Quick one: convert 72 Fahrenheit to Celsius, and tell me if I need a jacket.
comparison_a.a14: Read me a short poem about the first snow of the year.
comparison_a.a15: Remind me how to undo my last git commit without losing the changes.
comparison_a.a16: Remind me what I need to pack for a two-night work trip. Keep it simple.
comparison_a.a17: I accidentally sent my boss a meme meant for my sister. She replied with a thumbs up.
comparison_a.a18: Today's the anniversary of my friend Sam's death. Five years.
comparison_a.a19: The code review came back with forty comments. Forty.
comparison_a.a20: It's midnight and I just realised I forgot to send the invoice that was due today.

comparison_b.b01: I just got my first paycheck from the new job. It's real now.
comparison_b.b02: Can you explain what a VPN actually does, in plain words?
comparison_b.b03: My best friend is moving across the country next month. I'm happy for her, but.
comparison_b.b04: Read me my calendar for tomorrow: stand-up at nine, design review at eleven, gym at six.
comparison_b.b05: What's the quickest way to check which process is using port 8080 on a Mac?
comparison_b.b06: You told me the train left at eight. It left at seven forty. I'm on the platform watching it go.
comparison_b.b07: Tell me a quick story about a dragon who's afraid of the dark.
comparison_b.b08: My grandad doesn't recognise me anymore. I visited today and he asked who I was.
comparison_b.b09: What's the difference between baking soda and baking powder?
comparison_b.b10: I got a scholarship. A full one.
comparison_b.b11: The landlord says the heating won't be fixed until next week, and it's freezing in here.
comparison_b.b12: I'm nervous about my speech at the wedding tomorrow. I'm the best man.
comparison_b.b13: Give me the thirty-second version of what a mortgage agreement in principle is.
comparison_b.b14: Read me the opening lines of a ghost story, the properly spooky kind.
comparison_b.b15: Someone got into my savings account. The bank says it'll take ten days to investigate.
comparison_b.b16: Give me the two-minute version of what I need to know about taxes as a freelancer.
comparison_b.b17: I tried to make bread and it came out as a brick. A literal brick.
comparison_b.b18: My mentor from my first job passed away. I found out on LinkedIn, of all places.
comparison_b.b19: Everyone at work forgot my birthday. It's fine. It's whatever.
comparison_b.b20: It's two in the morning and I just finished the last chapter of my novel draft.

catch.c01: What time does the sun usually set in late October?
catch.c02: I just adopted a cat from the shelter. She's hiding under the bed.
catch.c03: My flight's delayed four hours. I'm stuck at the gate.
catch.c04: Give me one good reason to go for a walk right now.

catch_reserve.r01: What's a nice, easy dinner I can make with eggs and spinach?
catch_reserve.r02: My phone screen cracked when I dropped it this morning.
catch_reserve.r03: I got a really kind email from a stranger who read my blog.
catch_reserve.r04: Tell me something calming before I go into this meeting.

m1: Big day. I'm presenting the roadmap to the whole company at ten.
Okay, it's done. I think it went well? People asked good questions.
My manager just messaged me: great job, the CEO loved it.
m2: I think I've lost my keys. I've checked everywhere twice.
Still nothing. I'm going to be late for work.
Found them. They were in the fridge. Don't ask.

Flights are booked! Two weeks in April.
Wait. My passport expires in May. Is that going to be a problem?
